items.stem: Which TWO raise vehicle utilisation? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Consolidating multiple small shipments into one load
options.rationale: Correct: consolidation fills capacity and cuts trips.

options.text: Planning backhauls so vehicles are not empty on return
options.rationale: Correct: backhauls use otherwise wasted return capacity.

options.text: Dispatching every order immediately in its own vehicle
Reducing the size of the fleet without changing demand
options.rationale: Shrinking the fleet alone does not raise utilisation of remaining vehicles.

items.stem: A hub-and-spoke network is typically chosen to:

options.text: Consolidate flows through hubs to gain economies of scale
options.rationale: Correct: hubs aggregate volume, lowering per-unit cost at the expense of some directness.

options.text: Guarantee the shortest possible distance for every shipment
options.rationale: Hub routing can add distance versus point-to-point.

options.text: Eliminate the need for any warehouses
options.rationale: Hubs are facilities, not the absence of them.
